questions.stem: A 24-Year-old primigravida patient is in labour at 42 weeks of POG. P/V examination findings are – os fully dilated, 70% effaced, membranes ruptured, the pelvis is adequate, and the fetal head station is +2. The uterine contractions are adequate at a rate of 3/10 min for 30 sec. After 45 minutes of full dilatation, now the mother is exhausted. The fetal heart rate was 100, with no beat-to-beat variability. She is a known case of grade 2 NYHA heart failure. Hence she was delivered with the help of a forceps application. Which of the following is not an indication of forceps delivery in the above question?

options.label: D
options.text: Known case of grade 2 NYHA heart failure
